description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Booz Allen Hamilton is hiring a university software developer to sustain legacy enterprise applications for its clients. The role supports application maintenance, troubleshooting, enhancements, and security upgrades while contributing to system modernization.
University Software Developer sustaining applications through enhancement, operational troubleshooting, maintenance, and security-driven system upgrades

Responsibilities:
• As a software sustainment engineer, you play a pivotal role in an application’s functional life
• From troubleshooting to fixing bugs, you’ll use your operations and maintenance skills to ensure that things run smoothly
• As a software sustainment engineer at Booz Allen, you’ll have an operational impact from day one
• Supporting a team of professionals, you’ll help maintain applications and keep systems working
• You’ll use programming and scripting languages as you continuously enhance and maintain the applications, troubleshoot any issues that arise operationally, and upgrade the systems to meet security requirements
• Most importantly, you’ll learn how we advise our clients on the best ways to improve and modernize the existing systems
• Work with us to help us secure crucial systems while watching them grow and modernize

Requirements:
• Experience with programming languages, including Java, JavaScript, C, C++, Assembly, Python, Perl, R, or Bash
• Experience with machine learning, data mining, statistics, or graph algorithms in academic or internship environments
• Experience with conducting research and writing software
• Ability to produce technical documentation and create design artifacts
• Ability to work independently and in teams
• Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
• Scheduled to obtain a Bachelor's degree by Winter 2026 or Summer 2027

Preferred:
• Possession of excellent critical thinking and analytical skills
• Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills
